Remark
[Basic properties of Lebesgue measure] ↗ thm:existence-lebesgue-measure 1. appE:E.1-rem-1\group Measure Theory

(i) The measure of a set with piecewise smooth boundary equals its volume.

(ii) Countable additivity implies \[ (2)\qquad |\emptyset |=0 \] and, for every countable family of measurable sets, \[ (3)\qquad \left|\bigcup _{k=1}^\infty A_k\right|\leq \sum _{k=1}^\infty |A_k|. \]
